name: Levirate Marriage
overview: Levirate marriage, as outlined in Deuteronomy 25:5, is a divinely instituted practice where the brother of a deceased man marries the widow if the deceased left no children, ensuring the continuation of the family line and fulfilling the duty of a husband's brother. This principle is illustrated in the narrative of Judah in Genesis 38:1 and the account of Boaz in Ruth 4:1, where family responsibility and kinship play a crucial role in preserving inheritance and legacy within God's covenant community.
